title: ai_governance_signoff_gate
claim: AI copy bottlenecks in B2B because teams check word quality instead of regulatory liability.
hook: AI copy fails at signoff, not generation.

evidence.detail: A three-tier liability audit model that replaces generic copy-editing with regulatory, technical, and commercial risk checks for industrial marketing teams.

slides.headline: AI copy fails at signoff, not generation.
Speed at generation creates a traffic jam at legal.
slides.body: Drafting takes two minutes. Review takes two weeks. Teams edit adjectives when they should audit claims.

items.label: Legal Signoff
items.detail: Blocked on factual liability and specs

slides.headline: Style guides cannot catch regulatory liabilities.
slides.body: Prompt templates fix tone of voice. They do not check if a tolerance claim violates a compliance filing.

items.label: Standard Review
items.detail: Checks brand tone, grammar, and formatting

items.label: Governance Review
items.detail: Checks spec limits, liabilities, and disclosures

slides.headline: Run a liability audit before human editing.
slides.body: Categorize every claim into three risk tiers before sending copy to technical or legal approvers.

items.label: Tier 3: Commercial
items.detail: Pricing, SLAs, legal terms. Full legal audit.

slides.headline: Filter hard claims out of soft messaging.
slides.body: Isolate performance data, compliance numbers, and regional standards into verified data tables first.

items.label: Source Verification
items.detail: Attach public filing link to every hard claim

items.label: Signoff Mapping
items.detail: Route only unverified claims to legal

slides.headline: Give legal a pass condition, not a document.
slides.body: Do not ask legal to read full drafts. Ask them to verify specific claims against pre-approved parameters.

items.label: Check 3: Attribution
items.detail: Is third-party data traced to source?

slides.headline: Signoff speed is an architecture problem.
slides.body: Build clear liability parameters into your workflow. Speed follows clarity, not better prompts.

items.detail: Slow edits, higher risk, legal friction

items.label: With Governance
items.detail: Clear gates, fast signoff, zero exposure

slides.headline: Governance precedes velocity.
slides.body: Clear risk parameters unlock faster deployment than any prompt library ever will.

caption:
AI copy fails at signoff, not generation.

Establishing clear AI governance for marketing teams requires moving past style guides and tackling regulatory exposure directly.

In enterprise industrial marketing, generation is easy. Approval is where campaigns die. The team generates twenty technical posts in minutes, then spends three weeks arguing with compliance over adjectives.

The fix is not training legal to read faster. The fix is changing what you ask them to do. Legal should never review tone; they should verify claim boundaries.

When you separate narrative copy from verifiable technical data, signoff times drop from weeks to hours.

Speed is a workflow structure, not a prompt skill.

Send this to whoever is responsible for managing brand risk and content approvals this quarter.
